purpose: Measure bounded candidate-subgraph localization and final Prompt conversion on a multi-domain scale ladder with currently audited Batch C edges.

layers.candidate: Primary: lexical Seed IDs for R0 versus bounded local-subgraph candidate IDs for R1.
layers.prompt: Secondary: Claim/Evidence bundles surviving selector and token budget.

decisionRules.CANDIDATE_LOCALIZATION_SIGNAL: At S50, R1 has >=1 paired candidate-source recall win, zero candidate source/evidence losses, and candidate size <=40.
decisionRules.SELECTOR_GAP: Candidate localization wins but final Prompt recall does not improve.
decisionRules.END_TO_END_RETRIEVAL_SIGNAL: Candidate and Prompt recall improve without >5% average Context token increase.
decisionRules.NO_CANDIDATE_BENEFIT: No R1 candidate recall win at any tier and no loss.
decisionRules.REGRESSION: Any R1 candidate required-source or evidence recall loss.
decisionRules.ENGINEERING_SCALE_BLOCKER: Full-corpus scans grow with corpus size; persistent indexes and local adjacency loading remain required.

interpretationLimits: Revealed Stage B Gold makes this a post-hoc mechanism diagnostic, not blind evidence.
Accepted Relations are DeepSeek proxy judgments pending independent human review.
Distractor corpora enlarge the search space but do not add audited cross-corpus edges.
A candidate localization win does not authorize default Graph Prompt expansion.
